_comment: SAMPLE DATA, NOT REAL SHELTERS. These mirror the four placeholder relief shelters in server/src/data/operations.json. Replace with the official list of relief camps / safe assembly points from SDMA and the district administrations (name, lat, lng), then set "sample" to false: only then does the app show a Directions button. Entries may give lat/lng, or `near` (a monitored place id) to borrow its position.
